instruction: Access the browser settings and find the privacy section where you can clear your browsing data including cookies and cached files.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Chrome's clear browsing data page (chrome://settings/clearBrowserData). Uses existing evaluator functions - is_expected_active_tab_approximate metric and active_url_from_accessTree getter. No new functions needed. Similar difficulty to original task (simple navigation).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies that the user navigated to Chrome's clear browsing data settings page (chrome://settings/clearBrowserData)
The getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' appropriately extracts the current active tab URL from the accessibility tree
The metric 'is_expected_active_tab_approximate' performs correct URL comparison, stripping query parameters for robustness
The expected URL 'chrome://settings/clearBrowserData' is semantically correct - this is the exact Chrome settings page where users can clear cookies and cached files
Complete coverage: the instruction asks to find the privacy section for clearing browsing data, and the evaluator verifies navigation to that exact page
No logical issues: the evaluation flow (extract URL -> compare -> return score) will work correctly at runtime
